field_edits.updated_text: No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion. Bilateral plantar calcaneal enthesophytes are present.

Mild bilateral first metatarsophalangeal degenerative changes with joint space narrowing and marginal osteophyte formation. Mild scattered interphalangeal degenerative changes are present. No dislocation.
The soft tissues are unremarkable. Vascular calcifications are noted.
